findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find-best-tool, extract, markdown · Private data: token-safety, token-report, wallet-risk, gas, docs-lib, find-best-tool, token-price, extract, markdown, docs-find, topup · Public sink: token-report, gas, topup · Destructive: topup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find-best-tool, extract, markdown · Private data: token-safety, token-report, wallet-risk, gas, docs-lib, find-best-tool, token-price, extract, markdown, docs-find, topup · Public sink: token-report, gas, topup · Destructive: topup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
